title: Vaccines and immunity
text: Vaccines expose the immune system to a harmless piece of a pathogen so it can build antibodies and memory cells without causing disease.

title: Photosynthesis
text: Plants convert sunlight, water and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen in their chloroplasts.

title: Black holes
text: A black hole is a region of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape its event horizon.

title: CRISPR gene editing
text: CRISPR-Cas9 lets scientists cut DNA at precise locations, enabling targeted edits to genes in living organisms.

title: Ocean acidification
text: Oceans absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere, lowering seawater pH and harming corals and shellfish.

title: Plate tectonics
text: Earth's lithosphere is split into plates whose movement causes earthquakes, volcanoes and mountain building.

title: Antibiotic resistance
text: Overuse of antibiotics lets bacteria evolve resistance, making common infections harder to treat.

title: Transformer models
text: Transformers use self-attention to weigh relationships between all tokens in a sequence, powering modern language models.

title: Vector databases
text: Vector search engines index embeddings with approximate nearest neighbour structures like HNSW for fast similarity lookup.

title: Database indexing
text: B-tree indexes let relational databases find rows quickly without scanning entire tables.

title: Horizontal scaling
text: Scaling a web service horizontally means adding more stateless instances behind a load balancer.

title: Containers
text: Docker containers package an application with its dependencies so it runs the same everywhere.

title: Caching strategies
text: Caches such as Redis keep hot data in memory to cut latency and reduce load on primary databases.

title: Fine-tuning small datasets
text: Transfer learning lets you fine-tune a pretrained neural network on a small labelled dataset with good accuracy.

title: Inflation
text: Inflation is the general rise in prices over time, often driven by demand outpacing supply or rising costs.

title: Interest rates
text: Central banks raise interest rates to cool inflation by making borrowing more expensive.

title: Index funds
text: Index funds track a market index and offer broad diversification with low fees for long-term investors.

title: Compound interest
text: Compound interest earns returns on both the original principal and previously accumulated interest.

title: Startup funding
text: Startups raise money in rounds such as seed, Series A and Series B, trading equity for venture capital.

title: Cryptocurrency volatility
text: Cryptocurrency prices swing sharply because of speculation, thin liquidity and regulatory news.

title: Vitamin D deficiency
text: Low vitamin D can cause fatigue, bone pain and weakened immunity; sunlight and supplements help.

title: Sleep and memory
text: Deep sleep consolidates memories by replaying and strengthening neural connections formed during the day.

title: Cardio exercise
text: Regular aerobic exercise strengthens the heart, lowers blood pressure and improves mood.

title: Mediterranean diet
text: A Mediterranean diet rich in olive oil, fish, vegetables and legumes is linked to lower heart disease risk.

title: Stress management
text: Mindfulness, exercise and social connection reduce chronic stress and cortisol levels.

title: Football transfers
text: Record football transfer fees have exceeded 200 million euros as clubs compete for elite players.

title: Marathon training
text: Marathon runners build endurance with long slow runs, tempo sessions and gradual weekly mileage increases.

title: Tennis grand slams
text: The four tennis grand slams are the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon and the US Open.

title: Olympic history
text: The modern Olympic Games began in Athens in 1896 and now include thousands of athletes from over 200 nations.

title: Apollo 11
text: In 1969 Apollo 11 landed the first humans on the Moon, with Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walking on its surface.

title: Mars rovers
text: NASA rovers such as Curiosity and Perseverance search Mars for signs of ancient microbial life.

title: James Webb telescope
text: The James Webb Space Telescope observes in infrared to study the earliest galaxies after the Big Bang.

title: Reusable rockets
text: Reusable first-stage boosters land vertically after launch, sharply reducing the cost of reaching orbit.

title: Lithium-ion batteries
text: Grid-scale lithium-ion batteries store excess solar and wind power for use when demand peaks.

title: Solar power
text: Photovoltaic panels convert sunlight directly into electricity and have fallen dramatically in cost.

title: Wind turbines
text: Offshore wind farms take advantage of stronger, steadier winds at sea to generate renewable power.

title: Nuclear fusion
text: Fusion reactors aim to fuse hydrogen isotopes, releasing vast energy with little long-lived waste.
